contact.name: Giving Team
contact.evidence_quote: Our Giving Team determines the right partners to bring into our network through a thorough process involving an application, deep research, background reviews and interviews. We’re generally looking to determine if partners connect to our impact pillars, have local expertise, sustainable programming, and impactful solutions.

contacts.rung: Other role. The Giving Team manages the Giving Fund and handles inquiries regarding impact and partnerships.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Send in your gently worn shoes, clothing and accessories in exchange for TOMS.com credit via our partnership with thredUP.
Klarna and TOMS have partnered to provide flexible online payment options for TOMS shoppers through “Buy now. Pay later.” More information is available on Klarna's website.

B Corp: We’re proud to be a certified B Corp since 2018. Our B Corp certification recognizes our commitment to high standards of social and environmental performance, transparency and accountability. We re-certified in 2024, and improved our score. The environment section was our greatest area of improvement — contributing to more than 50% of our new points.

Leather Working Group (LWG): LWG certifies leather manufacturing facilities based on environmental performance in areas, such as water and energy use, air emissions and waste. Through our partnership with LWG we support responsible manufacturing and we source 100% of our leather from gold and silver rated LWG leather manufacturers.
Canopy: Being committed to Canopy’s conservation standards encourages us to continue to source all wood-based material we use from sustainably-managed forests.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: We're currently looking to fill a variety of positions in our Los Angeles headquarters. Learn more about Jobs at TOMS.

network.stated_total_quote: Since 2006, we have worked with over 205 non-governmental organizations, international humanitarian organizations and social enterprises. The partners and countries where TOMS works are assessed annually based on partners’ needs, so it does change from time to time. In 2024, TOMS worked with 32 partners.
network.coverage_note: TOMS is a for-profit retail company, not an educational institution. It does not have Erasmus+ partnerships or academic mobility programs.
